Third-party front-end libraries bundled locally (no CDN is used at runtime):

  bootstrap.min.css, bootstrap.bundle.min.js   Bootstrap 5.3.3   MIT licence   https://getbootstrap.com
  chart.umd.js                                 Chart.js 4.4.4    MIT licence   https://www.chartjs.org
  ../img/icons.svg                             Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3 (subset, as an SVG sprite)   MIT licence

Icons are SVG shapes, not an icon font, so the only font used by the application is Times New Roman.
